mapper.select: SELECT c.`id`, c.`novel_id`, c.`title`, c.`total_words`, c.`sort_order`, c.`create_time`, c.`update_time` FROM `novel_chapter` c INNER JOIN `novel` n ON n.`id` = c.`novel_id` WHERE c.`novel_id` = #{novelId} AND n.`user_id` = #{userId} AND n.`deleted` = 0 ORDER BY c.`sort_order`, c.`id`
mapper.update: UPDATE `novel_chapter` c INNER JOIN `novel` n ON n.`id` = c.`novel_id` SET c.`title` = #{chapter.title}, c.`content` = #{chapter.content,typeHandler=com.shiyq.handler.StringListTypeHandler}, c.`total_words` = #{chapter.totalWords}, c.`update_time` = NOW() WHERE c.`id` = #{chapter.id} AND n.`user_id` = #{userId} AND n.`deleted` = 0
